reading_note: The arc traces how the realm of self-love generates its whole hierarchy of falsity in opposition to divine truth. It begins by distinguishing the two fundamental substances — the Greatness (heaven of love) and its hidden goods, against which falsity-from-evil rises and seeks to plant itself permanently in the natural mind. From this rooting comes a successive begetting in five "times" or degrees: first, the inhabitants of the land of darkness; then a pouring-forth from the matrix of self-love that produces the trees of death (perceptions of falsity); then the staining/painting of these with appearances of truth; then the bitter fruits (evil works) borne on five trees in five storehouses; finally the five worlds of flesh — the complete corporeal organization of self-love with male/female (will/understanding) portions mingling. The whole structure stands erect against the First Man (divine truth descending). The teaching closes with the twelve zodiacal spirits of error — the complete circuit of false states — which the First Man finally humbles. The arc: substance → rooting → pouring → staining → fruiting → embodying → opposing → being humbled by truth.
